# Web3 Operational Security Standard (W3OS)

> W3OS is an open standard defining operational security requirements for Web3 organizations: wallets and multisigs, endpoints, communications, DevOps, financial controls, AI agent usage, and smart contract operations. It complements code audits with the organizational controls that prevent key compromise, social engineering, and operational loss.

## Requirements

- [Domain 1: Wallet & Multi-Sig Management](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/W3OSC/web3-opsec-standard/main/requirements/01-wallet-multisig.md): 23 controls
- [Domain 2: Endpoint Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/W3OSC/web3-opsec-standard/main/requirements/02-endpoints.md): 13 controls
- [Domain 3: Communications & Social Media](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/W3OSC/web3-opsec-standard/main/requirements/03-communications-socials.md): 8 controls
- [Domain 4: DevOps & Infrastructure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/W3OSC/web3-opsec-standard/main/requirements/04-devops-infrastructure.md): 22 controls
- [Domain 5: General Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/W3OSC/web3-opsec-standard/main/requirements/05-general-security.md): 25 controls
- [Domain 6: Financial Controls & Banking Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/W3OSC/web3-opsec-standard/main/requirements/06-financial-controls.md): 20 controls
- [Domain 7: AI Agent Operational Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/W3OSC/web3-opsec-standard/main/requirements/07-ai-agent-opsec.md): 7 controls
- [Domain 8: Smart Contract & Protocol Operations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/W3OSC/web3-opsec-standard/main/requirements/08-smart-contract-operations.md): 18 controls
